messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: PROD_CANARY_RELEASE (PD12345) — increase in 5xxs for staged release v2.4.2. Observed in eu-west-1 canary pool. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345

ploy-bot: Staged rollout currently at 30% traffic (deploy-2026-03-15-1245). Auto-rollback policy: off. To set traffic to 0: `redwood rollout set --id deploy-2026-03-15-1245 --traffic 0`

sasha: ack — i'm oncall and taking lead. grabbing logs now.

matt: seeing 502/503s from the canary fleet, p99 token latency jumped from 120ms -> 2.4s. quick grep of logs shows repeated kernel OOMs on quantized workers:

```
[2026-03-15T12:45:12Z] worker-quant-07 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 32456 (python)
[2026-03-15T12:45:13Z] srv-gen-agg ERROR 502 upstream write failed: short read
[2026-03-15T12:45:14Z] model-runtime WARNING KV cache miss ratio spiked to 0.82
```

matt: looks like the new quant path is hitting OOMs when sequence len > 1024. reproducing locally on a dev GPU with load repro now.

jamie: any confirmed customer impact? which tenants hit? I can prepare comms if needed.

sasha: prelim telemetry shows 3 dedicated customers (enterprise-omega, fintech-beta, ml-saas) saw elevated 5xxs in eu-west for embeddings/generation calls. Status page still green but error budget alerts firing in internal dashboards.

carla: +1 on escalations. i'm ready to trigger rollback if SRE approves. what do we want: pause rollout, divert traffic, or immediate rollback?

matt: recommend pause/divert. immediate rollback would be fine but want to preserve traces for postmortem. steps:
- set canary traffic to 0
- pin production routing to previous model v2.4.1

sasha: i'll set traffic to 0 now. executing:

```
# set canary traffic to 0
redwood rollout set --id deploy-2026-03-15-1245 --traffic 0
# pin routes back to previous model
redwood route set --service generation --model v2.4.1 --weight 100
```

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by sasha (@sasha)

dave: i'll open an incident page and prep customer-facing blurb. tagging support to DM affected accounts.

carla: SRE will run health checks after routing change. if errors continue we'll trigger full rollback: `redwood deploy rollback deploy-2026-03-15-1245`

sasha: traffic set to 0 — observed immediate drop in 5xx rate on canary nodes. staging telemetry shows p95 back to baseline within ~20s. monitoring graphs: https://telemetry.example/graphs/PD12345

matt: confirming kernel OOMs stopped once quant path traffic dropped. keeping canary offline for 30m while we triage quantization memory handling.

dave: posted initial note to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased errors for staged canary release; mitigation in progress, rollback paused while we validate fix. Affected customers contacted." will update in 10m.

jamie: thanks — can we set severity and ETA for next update? mark PD incident as 'mitigation in progress' and update stakeholders.

sasha: setting severity P1 -> P2 (no global outage, limited customer impact). next update in 10m. assigning postmortem to matt/carla.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 status changed: mitigation_in_progress — canary traffic 0%. follow-up updates in thread.

carla: handoff to SRE for triage at 4712348915 — i'll coordinate with infra to reproduce memory spike and run debug build 2026-03-15-qtest on canary nodes.

sasha: acknowledged handoff. i'll stay on thread for escalation. ping me if rollback needed.

matt: will run memory profiling and open a PR with a potential guard for seq_len>1024. if we can't fix in 30m we rollback.

dave: support notified affected customers via DMs; ops channel has list. keeping status page at "investigating -> monitoring".

sasha: thanks all. monitoring continues. next update 4712348925.

incident-bot: This thread will remain open for follow-ups and the incident record PD12345 will be updated with timeline and mitigation steps.
